entries.name: Dumpster
entries.style: low-poly, gradient atlas flattened (KayKit City Builder Bits 2023)

source.author: Kay Lousberg
source.note: Plan row was the Quaternius dumpster on the poly.pizza CDN, which answers with a Cloudflare challenge; substituted with KayKit City Builder Bits dumpster.gltf (+ .bin and the citybits_texture.png atlas) from the pack GitHub repo, pinned to commit 63976910ca04d16f0fc531b9c614244be8128713 (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg), the same pin and atlas as the library hydrant. Rendered against Kenney City Kit Roads dumpster.glb (reads as a sloped bin with a flat slab lid, oddly deep, 2.3 m long) and Kenney Retro Urban Kit detail-dumpster-closed.glb (a 22-triangle wedge): this one reads best, a classic front-load skip with a moulded rim, two reinforcing bands and two closed lid flaps hinged at the back on raised hinge blocks. Facing +Z: the lid slopes down to the front, hinges at the back, as source (no yaw). Colours for night alleys on the indigo script: the ten flattened greens of the body are one body role (accent red, sky shade), the two lid greys one lid role (moon, sky shade), both shades clear of the ink. Height 1.2 m (real 1.2-1.4 m); the stylized source is chunky, so at that height it is 2.14 m wide and 1.33 m deep (real ~1.8-2 m wide). Static, no clips.
